info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Login Forms Submission API
info.description: The Login Forms Submission API facilitates the integration of user authentication by allowing institutions to submit user login forms. This endpoint enables seamless connection to various institutions based on a specified institution ID, ensuring secure and efficient handling of login credentials. Typically used by developers implementing authentication for applications serving multiple financial institutions, this API streamlines the login process while maintaining user data security. Consumers can leverage this API to enhance user experiences across their platforms.

post.summary: Create a Login Form for the Institution.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a login form for the specified institution, identified by its unique identifier. Utilize this functionality to streamline the login process for users associated with the institution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a login form for the institution with the identifier RES-100045. The information provided will be used to authenticate the user and initiate a login session.
